Method of Attack: Malicious VBScript hidden inside MSI filename executed by thumbnailer script when parsing MSI files to extract icons
Execution of code embedded in MSI filename when accessed via GNOME Files
Impacted Systems: Linux systems using GNOME desktop with GNOME Files (Nautilus)
Attack Vector: Tricking victim into downloading malicious MSI file
Drive-by downloads via web browsers with auto-download settings
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious MSI files with VBScript in filename
File named badtaste.txt dropped by proof of concept
